q: ................... is built with NAND flash memory, offering much faster performance, durability (no moving parts), and energy efficiency compared to HDDs.
explain: **SSDs** مبنية بـ **NAND flash** وأسرع وأمتن (مفيهاش أجزاء متحركة) وموفرة للطاقة.

q: ............... are one of the most advanced storage technologies used today in data centers, enterprise systems, and personal computing, with ultra-low latency.
explain: **NVMe (Non-Volatile Memory Express)**: من أحدث التقنيات، ultra-low latency و throughput عالي جدًا مقارنة بـ SATA SSDs.

q: ................ is small form-factor, non-volatile storage used in USB drives, smartphones, and embedded systems.
explain: **Flash Memory**: صغيرة و non-volatile في الـ USB والموبايلات والأنظمة المدمجة.

q: The earliest form of data storage (1890s–1960s), where data was represented by holes, is:
explain: **Punch Cards** أقدم شكل، والبيانات ثقوب بتتعالج sequentially.

q: Magnetic tapes are still used today mainly for:
choices: Archival and backup due to cost-effectiveness and durability
explain: الـ **Magnetic tapes** (من الخمسينات) لسه بتستخدم في **archival و backup** لأنها رخيصة ومتينة.

q: Data center environment refers to:
choices: The controlled physical conditions (temperature, humidity, airflow) maintained within a data center
explain: **Data center environment** = الظروف الفيزيائية المتحكم فيها: **temperature, humidity, airflow**.

q: An application performs computing operations by sending ______ to the OS and storage devices.
explain: الـ **Application** بيبعت **R/W requests** للـ OS وأجهزة التخزين.

q: In data centers, applications are grouped into ...................
explain: التصنيفات: **Business, Infrastructure management, Data protection, Security** يعني **All of them**.

q: .............. acts as a bridge between applications and storage, ensuring data is efficiently organized, retrieved, and managed.
explain: الـ **DBMS** جسر بين الـ applications والتخزين.

q: When an application requests data, the DBMS:
choices: Reads the platters directly without the OS
Processes the request and instructs the operating system to fetch the data from storage
Sends the request to the printer
explain: الـ DBMS **بيعالج الطلب ويأمر الـ OS** يجيب البيانات.

q: ............... is the computer where applications run and data is stored/retrieved.
explain: الـ **Host (compute system)**.

q: Which is a SOFTWARE component of a host?
explain: Software: **OS, file system, logical volume manager, device drivers**. والباقي hardware.

q: ............ is the link between hosts and peripheral devices (e.g., storage, printers).
explain: **Connectivity** = الرابط بين الـ hosts والأجهزة الطرفية.

q: .........is a set of paths enabling data transfer within a computer.
explain: **Bus: A set of paths enabling data transfer within a computer** (CPU ↔ memory).

q: ............. is a specialized outlet for host-to-external device connectivity.
explain: **Port: Specialized outlet for host-to-external device connectivity**.

q: ............ connect hosts to devices via copper or fiber.
explain: **Cables** نحاس أو fiber.

q: The three physical components of connectivity between the host and storage are:
explain: Physical: **Bus, Port, Cable**. أما PCI و IDE و SCSI فدي **logical**.

q: ................. is an example of logical components of connectivity.
explain: الـ Logical components: **PCI, IDE/ATA, SCSI**، يعني **All of them**.

q: Which protocol is the most popular for modern disks, offering high performance at low cost?
explain: **IDE/ATA: Most popular protocol for modern disks. High performance at low cost**.

q: Which interface is preferred in high-end systems but less common in PCs due to higher cost?
explain: **SCSI**: preferred in high-end systems وأغلى.

q: Which standard for expansion cards supports plug-and-play (auto-detects and configures new devices)?
explain: **PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect)**: expansion cards و plug-and-play.

q: Which is a limitation of tape storage?
choices: Sequential access makes random access slow
Very low capacity in modern versions
explain: Tape: **sequential access ← random access بطيء**، و application واحد في المرة، و management overhead عالي.

q: Optical disks offer WORM, which means:
choices: Write Once, Read Many — ensuring data integrity
explain: **WORM = Write Once, Read Many** ← بيضمن data integrity.

q: Why are optical disks not suitable for enterprise data centers?
explain: **Limitations: Low capacity and speed → not suitable for enterprise data centers**.

q: ................. is a circular disk inside an HDD, coated with magnetic material on both sides to store data in binary form.
explain: **Platter**: قرص دائري مغطّى بمادة مغناطيسية على الوجهين.

q: ............. holds and connects all platters in an HDD and is powered by a motor that spins them at constant high speeds.
explain: **Spindle**: بيلف الـ platters بـ 7,200 أو 10,000 أو 15,000 rpm.

q: .................. holds the R/W heads and moves them to the correct position on the platter.
explain: **Actuator arm assembly**: بيمسك ويحرك كل الـ heads مع بعض.

q: .................... is a circuit board at the bottom of the disk drive containing a microprocessor, memory, circuitry, and firmware.
explain: **Controller**: بيدير الموتور والـ actuator والـ heads والتواصل مع الـ host.

q: Typical spindle speeds are:
If a malfunction causes the R/W head to touch the platter outside the landing zone, it causes a:
explain: **Head crash**: بيخدش السطح ويبوّظ الـ head، وغالبًا بيضيّع البيانات.

q: How many R/W heads does each platter have?
explain: **Each platter has two R/W heads, one for each surface**.

q: Disk storage is organized into ............... (concentric rings).
explain: **Tracks** = concentric rings، وكثافتها بالـ TPI.

q: Each track is divided into ..................., the smallest addressable storage unit.
explain: **Sectors**: أصغر وحدة ليها عنوان، وعادة 512 bytes بيانات + metadata.

q: ............... is the set of aligned tracks across all platter surfaces.
explain: **Cylinder** = نفس الـ track على كل الأسطح.

q: A sector typically holds ______ of user data.
explain: **typically 512 bytes of user data plus metadata**.

q: ....................... improves efficiency by dividing tracks into zones.
explain: **ZBR** بيقسم الـ tracks لـ zones.

q: In Zoned Bit Recording, outer zones have:
choices: More sectors per track than inner zones
The same as every other zone
explain: **outer zones have more sectors, while inner zones have fewer**، وكل tracks الـ zone الواحدة ليها نفس العدد.

q: ............... is the time for the R/W head to move to the correct track.
explain: **Seek Time**، وكل ما يقل الـ random access يتحسن.

q: ............... is the time for the platter to rotate the requested sector under the R/W head.
explain: **Rotational Latency**، والمتوسط = **½ rotation time**.

q: Average rotational latency equals:
explain: **Average latency = ½ rotation time**. مثلًا 15,000 rpm ← لفة = 4 ms ← latency = **2 ms**.

q: For a disk spinning at 7,200 rpm, the average rotational latency is approximately:
explain: زمن اللفة = 60/7200 = 8.33 ms، والـ average = النص = **4.17 ms**.

q: ................. is the average speed at which a disk drive delivers data to the Host Bus Adapter.
explain: **Data Transfer Rate** = السرعة لحد الـ HBA.

q: In host access to data, the request is translated into a ______ which the controller maps to a physical location (track, sector, head).
explain: الطلب بيتحول لـ **LBA**، والـ controller بيحوله لمكان فيزيائي.

q: ................ is a type of data storage attached directly to a computer without going through a network.
explain: **DAS (Direct-Attached Storage)**.

q: ............ is a technology used in SATA disk drives to improve performance by reordering commands for optimal execution.
explain: **NCQ** بيرتب الأوامر عشان يقلل حركة الـ head والـ latency.

q: NCQ offers little to no benefit for:
explain: **Little to no benefit for sequential access**، وبيشتغل أحسن مع multi-threaded workloads.

q: A typical USB flash drive includes ....................
explain: الفلاشة فيها **USB connector, mass storage controller, flash memory chips, crystal oscillator** وغيرهم.

q: Limitations of flash drives include ................
explain: القيود: **higher cost per GB، limited write/erase cycles (wear-leveling)، data recovery أصعب**.

q: Which non-volatile memory type is dominant in storage devices like SSDs and USB drives?
explain: **NAND being dominant in storage devices**.

q: Which statement comparing HDDs and flash drives is TRUE?
choices: HDDs are cheaper per GB; flash drives are faster and more durable
Flash drives are cheaper per GB
explain: **HDD** أرخص لكل GB وسعته أكبر · **Flash** أسرع وأمتن وصامت بس أغلى.
